        public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader scanner, PrintWriter out) {
            int n = scanner.nextInt();
            int k = scanner.nextInt();
            int[] oddEven = new int[n];
            int[] arr = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                arr[i] = scanner.nextInt();
                if (i == 0) {
                    if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
                        oddEven[i] = 1;
                    } else oddEven[i] = -1;
                    continue;

                } else oddEven[i] = oddEven[i - 1] - 1;
            }
            node[] diffArr = new node[n - 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
                diffArr[i] = new node();

            int ans = 0;
            Arrays.sort(diffArr, new node());

                    if (k - diffArr[i].diff >= 0) {
                        ans++;
                        k = k - diffArr[i].diff;
                    }

                }
            }
            System.out.println(ans);
        }

    }

    static class InputReader {
        private InputStream stream;
        private byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int curChar;
        private int numChars;
        private InputReader.SpaceCharFilter filter;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int read() {
            if (numChars == -1) {
                throw new InputMismatchException();
            }
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try {
                    numChars = stream.read(buf);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new InputMismatchException();
                }
                if (numChars <= 0) {
                    return -1;
                }
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
                c = read();
            }
            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sgn = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                    throw new InputMismatchException();
                }
                res *= 10;
                res += c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
            return res * sgn;
        }

        public boolean isSpaceChar(int c) {
            if (filter != null) {
                return filter.isSpaceChar(c);
            }
            return isWhitespace(c);
        }

        public static boolean isWhitespace(int c) {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
        }

        public interface SpaceCharFilter {
            public boolean isSpaceChar(int ch);

        }

    }

    static class node implements Comparator<node> {
        int diff;
        int indx;


        public int compare(node o1, node o2) {
            if (o1.diff - o2.diff != 0)
                return o1.diff - o2.diff;
            else return o1.indx - o2.indx;
        }

    }

import sys

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self):
        self.stream = sys.stdin

    def read(self):
        c = self.stream.read(1)
        if c == '':
            return -1
        return ord(c)

    def nextInt(self):
        c = self.read()
        while c <= 32:
            c = self.read()
        sgn = 1
        if c == 45:
            sgn = -1
            c = self.read()
        res = 0
        while c >= 48 and c <= 57:
            res = res * 10 + c - 48
            c = self.read()
        while c <= 32:
            c = self.read()
        return res * sgn

def solve():
    n = int(input())
    k = int(input())
    oddEven = [0] * n
    arr = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        arr[i] = int(input())
        if i == 0:
            if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
                oddEven[i] = 1
            else:
                oddEven[i] = -1
            continue
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            oddEven[i] = oddEven[i - 1] + 1
        else:

    diffArr = []
    for i in range(n - 1):
        diffArr.append({'diff': abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]), 'indx': i})
    diffArr.sort(key=lambda x: (x['diff'], x['indx']))
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if k >= diffArr[i]['diff'] and oddEven[diffArr[i]['indx']] == 0:
            if k - diffArr[i]['diff'] >= 0:
                ans += 1
                k -= diffArr[i]['diff']
    print(ans)
